title: Triangulated closure of the integral constructible scalar-extension image
statement: For prime ℓ and finite normed E/ℚ_ℓ and a scheme X with Noetherian underlying space, use the actual integral scalar-extension functor of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], restricted to the full subcategory of integral bounded constructible complexes. Its essential image in the ambient continuous E derived category is a triangulated object property. This is only zero, shift and triangle closure of that image; it does not assert essential surjectivity or full faithfulness of the integral functor.

source.place: Lemma 6.8.12 and the denominator-clearing part of Proposition 6.8.14(2), before essential surjectivity

proof.text: Use lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-serre to give the integral bounded constructible full subcategory its triangulated structure. The actual derived extension is triangulated by its extension-restriction adjunction, hence preserves zero and commutes with shifts. Essential-image witnesses give zero and shift closure.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-continuous-constructible-integral-denominators to any morphism between images. It gives an integral lift after multiplication by a power of ℓ. Multiplication by ℓ is invertible on rational coefficient modules: prove it on continuous E-valued functions, transport through the coefficient pullback, tensor the regular-module isomorphism with any module, and then test on derived homology. Powers are therefore invertible on every rational derived object.

Complete the integral morphism to a distinguished triangle in the bounded constructible category and apply scalar extension. The source automorphism given by multiplication by ℓ^n identifies its first arrow with the given morphism. The triangle isomorphism axiom identifies the third vertices. Combine with arbitrary essential-image endpoint isomorphisms. Rotation gives the required triangulated object property.

proof_origin.note: A4 Lean proof from the proved actual coefficient telescope and denominator calculation; the only new hole is uniformly bounded-below sequential integral Hom continuity. No fullness of integral scalar extension is assumed.

Mathlib has triangulated closure for a full triangulated functor. The integral scalar-extension functor is not full; one needs lifting after multiplying by a power of ℓ.
